name: Executioners Guild
descr: Play the Executioners Guild if you want to strike down your targets with lethal precision.

foundations.name: First Strike
foundations.text: The first time in a scene you succeed on an attack, you deal double damage.

foundations.name: Ambush
foundations.text: Your "Marked for Death" feature uses **d6s** instead of d4s.

specializations.name: Death Strike
specializations.text: When you deal Severe damage to a creature, you can **mark a Stress** to force them to mark an additional Hit Point.

specializations.name: Scorpion's Poise
specializations.text: You gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against attacks made by a creature you've _Marked for_ _Death_.

masteries.name: True Strike
masteries.text: Once per long rest when you fail an attack, you can **spend a Hope** to make it a success instead.

masteries.name: Backstab
masteries.text: Your "Marked for Death" feature uses **d8s** instead of d6s.
